consumer: The frontend inventory panel renderer reading avatar.carried_items[] from the snapshot to ask 'what top-level items is this character holding, so I can list them?' — it SHOWS raw possession state, computes no predicate.
scope: Only the character's own carried items, enumerated top-level: wielded + worn + inventory stacks, WITHOUT recursing into container/gun/magazine contents and WITHOUT reaching nearby/map items.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and ctx.u.inv_const_slice() and emits each top-level item's raw fields (type_id, name, symbol, location, charges) as authoritative state; it does not recurse into contents (cf. visit_internal) and does not compute a has_items yes/no (cf. set_has_items).
divergence: Player wears a backpack containing a knife. Correct (S, top-level): the held list shows the backpack. A wrong answer that recurses via visit_items into the backpack and lists the knife as a top-level held item — or that reports a has_items predicate verdict instead of the raw item rows — is thereby exposed.
